The perspective looks into a dimly lit interior space with curved walls, possibly a panopticon-style structure or a rounded cell block. A small barred window is visible in the background. The foreground is dominated by the thick, dark grid of the cell bars.

The vertical bars show slight inconsistency in thickness and alignment near the top curve, which may indicate minor geometric warping rather than perfect optical perspective.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a prison/correctional facility and not a generic basement or jail set.
To verify the spatial relationship between the foreground bars and the background wall, ensuring no melting or depth collapse.
To check for edge bleeding or fusion between the bars and the background, ensuring they are distinct physical objects.
To assess the overall realism, lighting consistency, and noise patterns typical of black and white photography vs AI generation.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the iron bars (straightness, consistent thickness)
Realism of the background wall texture and lighting
Consistency of shadows cast by the bars onto the background
Absence of morphing or melting at the intersection of bars and frame
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the physics of the light source. In AI images, shadows from complex grids like bars often fail to align with a single light source. Check if the shadow falloff on the curved back wall is physically consistent with the foreground bars. Also, verify if the 'grain' in the image looks like natural film grain or AI-generated noise patterns.
